name: Eleonora Bern
original_name: エレオノーラ・ベルン
source:
She is a female bishop who is concerned about the corruption and decay of the church in the service state and aims for its reform. Even though she has risen to the position of bishop through her steady and sincere activities, she still struggles to help the elderly, women, and children who are oppressed in her country of service.
Because of this, she often clashes with the upper echelons of the church and the state. Even so, she is a woman of compassion and faith who is never intimidated or frustrated.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1014490]Getchu[/url]]
